title: Quick Shattering Peruvian Daikon Empanada
description: A unique Peruvian empanada recipe featuring daikon, a pasta-water emulsion, and a shattering crust.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, and sugar.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and rub until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 2-3 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired empanada size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
In a small bowl, beat the eggs and mix with the grated coconut milk.
Brush the egg mixture onto the center of each dough circle, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Place a few slices of daikon on one half of the dough circle, then fold the other half over to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada and use a fork to crimp the seam.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the pasta water emulsion.
Bake the empanadas for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
